title: tabernaemontana amblyocarpa

It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids such as voacangine and voacristine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
